display_long_description:
The ultimate off-road truck simulator for Meta Quest VR.

Leave the roads behind and take powerful trucks into a massive world of mud, snow, mountains, rocky trails, rivers, and extreme terrain.

This isn't city driving. This isn't highway cruising. This is off-road trucking in VR.

Fight through deep mud, climb steep mountain trails, cross rivers, push through snow, and haul heavy cargo across challenging routes. Test your truck's power, traction, and your driving skills.

CONQUER THE TERRAIN

🌲 Off-Road Driving — Explore forests, mountains, muddy trails, rocky paths, and rugged terrain.

🛞 Mud & Rough Terrain — Battle deep mud, steep slopes, uneven ground, and difficult trails.

❄️ Snow & Ice — Drive through challenging snowy terrain and fight for traction.

⛰️ Mountain Trails — Tackle steep climbs, narrow paths, rocky roads, and dangerous descents.

🌊 Water Crossings — Navigate rivers and difficult crossings while exploring the wilderness.

📦 Cargo Hauling — Transport cargo across demanding off-road routes.

🚛 Multiple Trucks — Drive powerful trucks with different handling and off-road capabilities.

🌍 Explore the Wilderness — Discover mountains, forests, mud, snow, trails, and extreme terrain.

BUILT FOR OFF-ROAD VR

✔ Immersive first-person truck driving
✔ Off-road truck physics
✔ Mud, snow, rocks, slopes, and rough terrain
✔ Cargo missions and exploration
✔ Multiple trucks
✔ Meta Quest 2, Quest 3 & Quest 3S

Grab the wheel. Choose your truck. Leave the road behind
